blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has signed a bill for the postponement of the Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE), Palace press officer Claire Castro said Friday. Castro said in a message, “[C]onfirmed… postponed na din ang bgy and sk election. pirmado na ni pbbm.” /mr READ: BSKE postponement: What it could mean for Cebu, CV READ: Why postpone BSKE again?...
